human_responsibility: Authorized the sampling checkpoint and remains responsible for retrieval, screening, interpretation, and manuscript claims.
ai_assistance: Codex drafted the builder and records, computed the deterministic selection, and ran consistency checks under author authorization.
allocation_method: Hamilton largest-remainder apportionment; equal remainders follow the declared primary-stratum order
claim_boundary: Selection fixes which records receive residual-risk inspection. It supplies no retrieval, screening, prevalence, exhaustive-coverage, or originality result.
